fields.label: App Name
fields.description: The wordmark next to the logo in the sidebar and on the login page. Blank uses System Settings > App Name.

fields.label: Accent Preset
fields.description: Picking a preset sets Brand Color; editing Brand Color switches this to Custom.

fields.label: Base Font Size (px)
fields.description: Site-wide default, 11–20. Every user can set their own from the Theme Customizer.

fields.label: Text Styles (JSON)
fields.description: Site defaults written by the Theme Customizer ("Save as site default"). Per element: size, weight, italic, color.

fields.label: Chart Engine
fields.description: ECharts (Apache-2.0) renders bar, line, pie, donut, percentage and mixed charts with the theme's colours, fonts and capped bar widths; it is loaded only on pages that draw a chart (≈205 KB gzip once). Heatmaps always use Frappe Charts.

fields.label: Chart Detail
fields.description: Rich: gradient bars with value labels, smooth area lines with average line and peak marker, a toolbox (bar/line switch, reset, save as image), data zoom on long series, donut centre total and percentages in the legend. Simple: flat fills and none of the extras.

fields.label: Chart Palette
fields.options:
Brand
Ocean
Sunset
Forest
Slate
Pastel
Custom
fields.description: Series colours for every chart and widget. Brand starts from the brand colour; Custom uses the eight colours below. Users may pick their own in the Theme Customizer.

fields.label: Custom Chart Colours
fields.description: Eight hex colours, comma separated, e.g. #1677ff,#13c2c2,#faad14,#722ed1,#52c41a,#eb2f96,#fa8c16,#2f54eb

fields.label: Icon Style
fields.description: Themate Business icons: Duotone adds a tinted layer behind the line work.

fields.label: Icon Size (px)
fields.description: Sidebar and workspace icons, 12–28.

fields.label: Icon Color
fields.description: Inherit follows the text next to the icon; Brand paints every Themate icon in the brand color.

fields.label: Show Language Switcher
fields.description: A language menu in the navbar, next to the user menu. Switching sets the user's language and reloads.

fields.label: Languages
fields.description: Empty means English and Arabic.

fields.label: Show Theme Customizer Button
fields.description: A palette button in the navbar that opens the Theme Customizer. The user menu entry is always there.

fields.label: Whitelabel
fields.description: Removes every Frappe / ERPNext reference from the desk: Help menu keeps only Keyboard Shortcuts; the Apps item, marketing banners in list sidebars, documentation and tutorial links, "Learn …" shortcuts, About dialog are hidden; links to frappe.io, erpnext.com, frappecloud.com, github.com/frappe and YouTube are hidden everywhere. On migrate: the standard email footer is disabled, the website footer's "Powered by" is replaced by the App Name, and System / Website Settings App Name are set to it when still "Frappe".

fields.label: Item: Basic Information / Stock & Valuation sections
fields.description: Adds two section breaks to the Item form (custom fields tm_basic_information_section and tm_stock_valuation_section) so the Details tab reads as Basic Information, Stock & Valuation, Description, Units of Measure. No field is hidden, moved between tabs, or changed. Turn off and migrate to remove them.

fields.label: Activity Display
fields.description: Where a record's comments and timeline show. Dialog: a button with a count in the page head opens them. Inline: under the form, as in stock Frappe. Users can choose their own in the Theme Customizer.

fields.label: Form Side Panel
fields.description: Which side of the screen a record's side panel (overview, assignments, attachments, tags, share) sits on. Auto: the end of the line, so right in English and left in Arabic. Users can choose their own in the Theme Customizer.

Turn the entire theme off — its stylesheets, the sidebar, the restyled pages and every script that rebuilds them — leaving the original Frappe desk. Use this to rule the theme in or out when diagnosing a UI problem. Each user can still choose for themselves (Theme Customizer > Themate Theme, or Themate User Preference). The per-area switches below only remove structure of one area; they do not bring back Frappe's own look.
fields.label: Enable Theme
Sidebar Theme
fields.description: Dark is the navy rail from the design; Light matches the page surface.

fields.label: Sidebar Background
fields.description: Navy by default (#0f1b3d). Hover, active and raised tones are derived from it.

fields.label: Sidebar Background Image
fields.description: Flowing ribbons behind the dark sidebar. Users may pick their own in the Theme Customizer.

fields.label: Background Image Colours
fields.description: Five hex colours, comma separated: background top, background bottom, wave dark, wave light, glow. Blank follows Sidebar Background.

fields.label: Groups and Hidden Items
fields.description: Optional. A row assigns a workspace to a sidebar section, or hides it (tick Hide). A child workspace (Recruitment under HR) with its own row, or whose parent is hidden, shows on its own in that section. Without rows: Home under Workspace, operational modules (Accounts, Buying, Selling, Stock, Assets, Manufacturing, Quality, Projects, Support, HR, Payroll) under Operations, everything else under Administration.

fields.label: Hidden Groups
fields.description: Sidebar sections to leave out entirely, comma separated, e.g. Administration, Governance. Matches the section title.

fields.label: Group Order
fields.description: Sidebar sections top to bottom, one per line, e.g. Workspace / Operations / Governance / Setup. Sections not listed follow in their usual order (Workspace, My Workspaces, Operations, Administration, then the custom ones). Matches the section title.

fields.label: Workspaces Outside Departments
fields.description: Departments are set in the Themate Department list. For someone who has departments: Show in their groups keeps the workspaces no department lists in their usual groups below; Hide leaves them out of the sidebar (still reachable by URL and search).

fields.label: Show My Workspaces
fields.description: The section with the user's private workspaces and the + that creates one.

fields.label: Show User Card
fields.description: Name, email and Log out at the bottom of the sidebar. The collapse control stays.

fields.label: Hide Workspace Shortcuts
fields.description: Workspaces show number cards, then charts, then shortcuts, then link groups. Tick to drop the shortcuts row entirely.

fields.label: Weekend
fields.description: The days every calendar shades as the weekend and hides with its Hide Weekends button. The week starts on the day set in System Settings > First Day of the Week. A calendar can have a weekend of its own in its Calendar Layout.

fields.label: Shade Weekend Days
fields.description: Hatch the weekend columns so a working day and a day off read differently at a glance.
